Dalla Vecchia F.M. (2020) - Raibliania calligarisi gen. n., sp. n., a new tanystropheid (Diapsida, Tanystropheidae) from the

Upper Triassic (Carnian) of northeastern Italy. Riv. It. Paleontol. Strat., 126(1): 197-222.
payload.description_html: Raibliania calligarisi gen. n., sp. n., holotype (MFSN 27532), tooth crown. The isolated tooth lies on the margin of an ischiadic fan. Scale bar equals 1 mm.
